title: Set 314

sentences.ko: 우리 고양이는 내가 그냥 빈둥거리고 있을 땐 완전 본 척도 안 하다가, 일 좀 하려고 노트북만 열면 그 순간 와서 키보드 위에 딱 드러누워.
sentences.text: My cat totally ignores me when I'm just sitting around, but the second I open my laptop to do some work, she comes over and lies right down on the keyboard.

alts.text: She totally ignores me when I'm just chilling, but the second I open my laptop to get some work done, boom, she's lying right on the keyboard.
My cat pays no attention to me at all when I am simply sitting idle, yet the moment I open my laptop to do some work, she comes over and lies down directly on the keyboard.

sentences.note: **the second** 는 ~하자마자, ~하는 순간이라는 뜻입니다. **sitting around** 는 딱히 하는 일 없이 빈둥거린다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 식기세척기를 고쳐 보려고 고치는 법 영상을 찾아봤거든. 근데 그러다 딴 걸 눌렀고, 두 시간 뒤엔 웬 남자가 녹슨 옛날 칼 닦는 걸 보고 있더라.
sentences.text: I was trying to fix the dishwasher, so I looked up a video on how to do it, but then I clicked on something else, and two hours later I was watching some guy clean up an old rusty knife.

alts.text: So I was gonna fix the dishwasher and pulled up a how-to video, but then I clicked on something else, and two hours later I'm watching some guy clean up an old rusty knife.

I was attempting to repair the dishwasher, so I searched for a video explaining how to do it. However, I then clicked on something else, and two hours later I found myself watching a man clean an old, rusted knife.

sentences.note: **looked up** 은 정보를 찾아보다라는 뜻입니다. casual 의 **pulled up** 은 화면에 영상이나 자료를 띄운다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 자, 우리 벌써 20분째 넘기기만 하고 있어. 이 예고편 끝날 때까지 못 정하면 그냥 그 베이킹 프로그램 또 보자. 그건 적어도 우리 둘 다 좋아하잖아.
sentences.text: Okay, we've been scrolling for like twenty minutes now. If we can't agree on something by the time this trailer's over, we're just watching that baking show again, because at least we both like that one.

alts.text: Dude, it's been like twenty minutes of scrolling. If we don't pick something by the end of this trailer, we're just putting the baking show on again. At least we both like it.

We have been scrolling for approximately twenty minutes. If we cannot agree on something by the time this trailer ends, we will simply watch that baking show again, since it is at least one we both enjoy.

sentences.note: **by the time** 은 ~할 때까지, ~할 무렵이면이라는 뜻입니다. **at least** 는 적어도, 그나마라는 말로 아쉬운 대로 좋은 점을 짚을 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 나 혼자 정하는 거면 차 빌려줄 텐데, 그 주에 남편이 출근할 때 차를 써야 해. 괜히 된다고 해 놓고 전날 밤에 전화해서 취소하고 싶진 않아.
sentences.text: I'd lend you the car if it were just up to me, but my husband needs it for work that week, and I don't want to say yes and then have to call you the night before and cancel.

alts.text: If it were just me, sure, take the car. But my husband needs it for work that week, and I don't wanna say yes and then call you the night before to cancel.
I would gladly lend you the car if the decision were mine alone, but my husband needs it for work that week, and I would not want to agree and then have to call you the night before to cancel.

sentences.note: **up to me** 는 내가 정할 일이라는 뜻입니다. **the night before** 는 어떤 일이 있기 바로 전날 밤을 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 윗집 남자가 가구를 옮기든지 뭘 하는 게 분명해. 매일 밤 11시쯤 되면 딱 우리 침대 위에서 뭘 질질 끄는 소리가 나거든. 올라가서 한마디 하고 싶은데, 아직 얼굴 한 번 본 적이 없어서 첫 대화가 불평하는 걸로 시작되는 건 정말 싫어.
sentences.text: The guy upstairs has to be moving furniture or something, because every night around eleven there's this dragging sound right over our bed. I'd go up and say something, but I've never even met him, so I really don't want our first conversation to be me complaining.

alts.text: Upstairs guy's gotta be moving furniture or something, 'cause every night around eleven there's this dragging noise right over our bed. I'd go say something, but I've never even met him, and I really don't want our first chat to be me complaining.

The gentleman who lives upstairs must be moving furniture or something similar, because every night at around eleven there is a dragging sound directly above our bed. I would go up and mention it, but I have never met him, and I would prefer that our first conversation not be a complaint.

sentences.note: **has to be** 는 ~임이 틀림없다는 강한 추측입니다. **say something** 은 거슬리는 일에 대해 한마디 하다라는 뜻으로 자주 씁니다.

reviewed: 3번 formal 의 programme 은 영국식 철자라 나머지 문장의 미국식 말투와 어긋나서 show 로 바꿨습니다.
2번 casual 의 restore 는 text 의 clean up 과 뜻이 달라서 clean up 으로 맞췄습니다.
